title: Kula Today
heading: Yesterday · Sun 22 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast light). Thermals were strongest (moderate) about 13:00 to 15:00. The upslope ran from about 09:15 to about 17:00. A high day for November: the base reached about 5,600 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 5,000 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 5,600 ft by the Kekoa camera, 600 ft higher than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 5,000 ft, off by 600 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,900 ft, off by 700 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest south about 13:52, crossing Kula Highway near Waiakoa. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 48 of 57 updates.
